items.event_description: Pilot-scale manufacturing of trans-hexahydro-2(3H)-benzoxazolone (trans-HBC) using HheG-catalyzed ring-opening of cyclohexene oxide with NaOCN. During the 10 L pilot-scale reaction in a 50 L reactor, an exothermic phenomenon (>35°C) was observed, and a temperature controller was used to maintain the reaction at 25°C.
items.special_treatment: Temperature controller was used to maintain the reaction at 25°C due to exothermic reaction. Cold water was recycled for temperature control.

items.event_description: Pilot-scale reaction duration for achieving 95% conversion.
HHDH screening and small-scale reactions (screening and characterization) performed at 35°C.
Two-phase reactions for substrate solubility and enzyme protection, performed at room temperature (approx. 25°C).
items.special_treatment: Use of ethyl acetate as co-solvent for improved yield and pH control.
